practice.title: Question Practice
practice.subtitle: Practice good questioning by classifying, transforming, and creating questions
practice.learnClosed: Has a fixed answer you can recall or look up. e.g. What three things does photosynthesis need?
practice.learnOpen: Allows many answers; you must reason and imagine. e.g. What would happen to Earth without photosynthesis?
